title: Informer
summary: INFORM'ER, noun One who animates, informs or gives intelligence. 1. One who communicates, or whose duty it is to communicate to a magistrate a knowledge of the violations of law, and bring the offende

inlines.v: INFORM'ER, noun One who animates, informs or gives intelligence. 1. One who communicates, or whose duty it is to communicate to a magistrate a knowledge of the violations of law, and bring the offenders to trial.
